text:
Maya (Sales): Heads-up: Equinox POC asking for on-prem SCIM gateway (air-gapped), multi-IdP per tenant (Okta + Azure), delegated domain-scoped admins, RBAC mapped to entitlement codes, and an initial Dedicated+Private price estimate.
Jon (SE): Quick Qs: user counts? sync cadence? will HR be source of truth?
Maya (Sales): ~85k users, daily deltas, contractors via JIT on login, HR is canonical for profiles but apps use SCIM for access. They also need bulk export for audits.
Ravi (Infra): Plan: ship a local SCIM gateway that stores deltas in an on-prem cache, communicates to Private control plane via mTLS or one-way sync. Use change tokens + pagination for deltas. Recommend 150 req/s headroom during sync. Cert rotation via agent script.
Lena (Security): I'll take the questionnaire. We support customer KMS for Private and can document log retention, network isolation, and erase-on-termination timelines. Need product to confirm exact retention window.
Jon (SE): For RBAC mapping propose SCIM extension with entitlement codes, e.g. {"urn:params:scim:ext:e": ["ENT-123","ENT-900"]} and group->role translation. Delegated admins via SCIM groups + limited admin scopes.
Maya (Sales): Ballpark pricing to start convo: Dedicated reserved pool $30k/mo, Private license $120k one-time, on-site install $10k one-time, premium connectors + SLA $3k/mo.
Ravi (Infra): Action items: provide install checklist & cert-rotation doc.
Jon (SE): Action items: schematic + small test dataset (10k) for delta+JIT validation.
Lena (Security): Action: initial questionnaire draft and KMS/HSM options.
Maya (Sales): I'll schedule POC kickoff for Tue 09:00 PT and share the questionnaire link.
